newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two French fighters crash in Mediterranean.
newsitem.headline: Two French fighters crash in Mediterranean.

text.p: Two French Mirage-2000N fighters on a training flight crashed into the Mediterranean on Monday but all four crew were rescued, the air force said.
An air force spokesman said further details of the accident were still coming in.
The four crew ejected to safety and were rescued by a ship. One of them was then flown by helicopter to a military base and taken from there to a hospital in Marseille.
The air force gave no reason for his hospitalisation.
The aircraft were based in Istres, southern France. An investigation was under way to determine the cause of the crash.
